svg.title: RabTech Academy Task 02 — Data-Flow Diagram
svg.desc: Data-flow diagram showing flows between the Assessor/Browser, LAB-01 Flask application, training database, and evidence collection. Also shows the host-only network path to LAB-02. Trust boundaries TB-01 through TB-05 are clearly marked. No data flows to the public internet.
svg.text: app.secret_key = "lab01-static-secret-key" in source → session forgery possible | STRIDE: Spoofing
Flask signed cookie — HMAC with static key
Assessor captures minimum-necessary evidence per RoE
Redact: passwords / session tokens / PIN → [REDACTED] before storage
Associated with Finding ID (FIND-YYYY-NNN) per findings/finding-template.md
NO data flows to internet / third-party systems
NO uncontrolled data extraction | NO persistence
No outbound / No internet / No pivoting
STOP if outbound traffic from LAB-02 detected
NO DATA FLOWS TO: Internet | GitHub.com (publication only) | College Networks | Personal Devices | Third-Party Services
All data remains within the isolated lab environment (127.0.0.1 and 192.168.56.0/24)
TB-03: Flask↔DB TB-04: Input→App TB-05: App→Priv
